# 4 bed detached house for sale

> New to the market Flannelly Auctioneers offer this spacious well-proportioned four bedroom detached single storey residence. Built in the 1980’s, it has all the attributes a family could possibly want, with generous living space sitting on an elevated site (0.296acres) overlooking the scenic rural countryside.

- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 128 m²
- Energetická náročnost: F
- Lokalita: Cunnagher Ross, Castlebar
- Cena: 180 000 €
